details.customer_stories_reason: Our judgment: AI assistants cannot see logo images, so logos are not evidence an AI can quote. A separate customer story page is text an AI can read and cite, so this category counts the distinct story pages linked one level below the customers page. Logos are listed for reference only.
details.scoring_rule: Our own fixed formula, not an AI judgment and not an outside standard: each of the 4 evidence categories is worth up to 25 points by how many distinct pieces of evidence the code rules found ({0: 0, 1: 15, 2: 20}, 25 points for 3 or more). Finding none is a score of 0, not missing data.

plain_finding.what_we_found: We read 3 pages on your site and found 2 specific numbers or statistics, 0 customer story pages, 0 named customer testimonials, and 4 third-party ratings or certifications.
plain_finding.what_it_costs_you: Your site is thin on customer story pages, so that part of your story rests on claims alone.
plain_finding.fix_it_today: Add real customer story pages next to your biggest claim on the homepage.

plain_finding.what_we_found: Your homepage was last meaningfully updated about 178 days ago, and it shows no sign of that date to anyone visiting. AI search tools often skip pages that look stale when they compare you against competitors.
plain_finding.what_it_costs_you: A customer asking an AI search tool for a recommendation may get a competitor whose site looks current while yours gets passed over.
plain_finding.fix_it_today: Add a visible last updated date near the top of your homepage and refresh one key section this week so the date is real.

details.voting_rule: Each field is judged on 3 independent runs. It is a conflict only if at least 2 runs say conflict, a match only if at least 2 runs say match, and unknown otherwise. The score counts voted conflicts: 0, 1, 2, 3 or more give 95, 60, 35, 10.

plain_finding.what_we_found: We compared what your website says about your product category and target customer against independent review sites for Feroot Security, and they match on every point.
plain_finding.what_it_costs_you: Nothing is lost here, so you can move on to the parts of your online profile that do need work.
plain_finding.fix_it_today: Check the same listings again next quarter so they stay accurate as your product and customers change.

details.method_note: Check weights are our own judgment. AI crawler access, structured data, and heading structure come from GEO-16 (Kumar and Palkhouski, 2025). The static content check comes from Vercel and MERJ's December 2024 research, which found GPTBot and ClaudeBot only fetch raw HTML and never execute JavaScript, so content that only appears after a client-side render is invisible to them even though a human visitor sees it fine.

plain_finding.what_we_found: AI search tools read only the raw text of your homepage and never run the scripts that build the full page. Your raw page has 535 words of real text, so these tools see a thin edition of what a customer sees in a browser.
plain_finding.what_it_costs_you: When a customer asks an AI search tool about your product, it answers from that thin text and may describe you poorly or point the customer to a competitor with clearer pages.
plain_finding.fix_it_today: Ask your web developer to render the homepage on the server so the full text is in the raw page, then check it by viewing the page source and confirming your main product copy appears there.
